name: @projectrevivesolutions/witness
description: Witness: the instrumentation MikeVan's AI Development Toolkit owns. A textual instrumenter on tree-sitter with Istanbul-shaped maps, a runtime that records which test reached every line, decision, and function, and the hooks that put it into Node's loader, a Vite build, and Playwright's workers. Shared by DeepTest and UntangleIt and bundled into each; see docs/witness.md for the runners it serves today.
